blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Coach Chot Reyes lamented the ejection of Henry Galinato in TNT’s 114-112 overtime loss to Converge in the PBA Governors’ Cup on Sunday for his headbutt on Alec Stockton during a heated exchange in the third quarter. Galinato was tossed with the Tropang 5G ahead after tensions boiled between him and Stockton, and Reyes felt the incident played a factor in the result at Ynares Center here. “Galinato getting thrown out was the turning point,” Reyes said. “He had the biggest plus-minus on our team.
